art.flagsHelp: Eight bits per sprite. The engine ignores them — your game reads them with map.flag(index, bit). Flag 0 can mean solid, flag 2 water — you decide.

map.title: Map 0
map.autotileSoon: Autotile needs a tileset convention — coming with the docs step.
map.gridHelp: Fine grid every tile, sky rule every eight — the screen is 20×11 tiles.
map.flagsHelp: Tints each tile by the first flag set on its sprite. Flags are per sprite, not per tile.

editor.viewerPoppedHint: The game keeps running in the floating panel and follows you across editors.

sound.sfxHelp: Sixteen slots your game plays with sound.play_sfx(slot). Click a slot to put the current pattern in it; click again to clear it.
sound.emptyHint: An instrument is a wave plus an envelope. Add one and the piano roll wakes up — five voices, sixteen slots.
sound.noInstrument: The inspector fills in once an instrument exists.
sound.name: Instrument name
sound.oscHelp: The raw wave. Square has a duty cycle; noise ignores pitch; PCM plays a sample.
sound.envHelp: Attack, decay, sustain, release — how loud the note is over its life.
sound.modHelp: Vibrato wobbles the pitch, arp cycles a chord, the filter shapes the tone.
sound.unused: Not used yet — paint some notes.
sound.sampleHint: Any audio file. Mixed to mono and resampled to 8-bit / 8 kHz — {{seconds}} s fits the budget.
